name: tinyide
description: IDE extensível baseada em navegador, empacotada para Linux.
author: tinyIde

scripts.prepare:plugins: npm ci --prefix plugins/terminal && npm ci --prefix plugins/markdown
scripts.build:plugins: npm run prepare:plugins && npm run build --prefix plugins/git && npm run build --prefix plugins/terminal && npm run build --prefix plugins/markdown
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run build:plugins
scripts.build:deb: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.test: vitest run packages modules apps/web/src apps/desktop --exclude '**/*.performance.test.ts' --exclude 'release/**'
scripts.test:performance: vitest run apps/web/src/file-browser.performance.test.ts --exclude 'release/**' && npm run test:performance --prefix plugins/python-venv
scripts.coverage:plugins: npm run coverage --prefix plugins/python && npm run coverage --prefix plugins/python-venv
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:core && npm run coverage:web-critical && npm run coverage:runtime-security && npm run coverage:plugins
scripts.typecheck:plugins: tsc -p plugins/python/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/python-venv/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/pytest/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/javascript/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/node-runtime/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/docker/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/terminal/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/git/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/search/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/markdown/jsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/database/jsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:performance && npm run coverage && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:plugins: npm test --prefix plugins/python && npm test --prefix plugins/python-venv && npm test --prefix plugins/pytest && npm test --prefix plugins/javascript && npm test --prefix plugins/node-runtime && npm test --prefix plugins/docker && npm test --prefix plugins/terminal && npm test --prefix plugins/git && npm test --prefix plugins/search && npm test --prefix plugins/markdown && npm test --prefix plugins/database
